stores.name: Flatpak + Flathub
stores.description: Universal Linux package system with Flathub repository

commands.ubuntu: sudo apt install flatpak && flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists flathub https://dl.flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
commands.fedora: sudo dnf install flatpak && flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists flathub https://dl.flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
commands.arch: sudo pacman -S flatpak && flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists flathub https://dl.flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
commands.mint: sudo apt install flatpak && flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists flathub https://dl.flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
